## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: New module `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/stability.py` with `finding_hash(tuple_dict) -> str` (stable hash of file+line_range+category), `jaccard(set_a, set_b) -> float` (zero-set edge case returns 1.0), `should_halt(current, prior, threshold=0.85) -> tuple[bool, str|None]`. Jaccard inputs are POST-RESOLUTION findings.

## TDD Requirement
Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_stability.py`.

Test functions (Given/When/Then):

1. `test_finding_hash_deterministic`
   - Given: same finding tuple ["src/foo.py", "10-20", "correctness"]
   - When: finding_hash called twice
   - Then: returns same hash

2. `test_finding_hash_distinguishes_different_findings`
   - Given: two different tuples (differ by file, line_range, or category)
   - When: finding_hash called on each
   - Then: hashes differ

3. `test_jaccard_identical_sets`
   - Given: two identical sets of 3 findings
   - When: jaccard(a, b)
   - Then: returns 1.0

4. `test_jaccard_disjoint_sets`
   - Given: two non-overlapping sets of 3 findings each
   - When: jaccard
   - Then: returns 0.0

5. `test_jaccard_partial_overlap`
   - Given: set A = {f1, f2, f3, f4}, set B = {f1, f2, f3} (3 of 4 overlap)
   - When: jaccard
   - Then: returns 3/4 = 0.75

6. `test_jaccard_zero_set_both_empty`
   - Given: two empty sets
   - When: jaccard([], [])
   - Then: returns 1.0 (full agreement edge case)

7. `test_jaccard_zero_set_one_empty`
   - Given: one empty set + one non-empty
   - When: jaccard
   - Then: returns 1.0 (zero-set edge case per Step 4.75 spec)

8. `test_should_halt_above_threshold`
   - Given: sets with Jaccard ≥ 0.85 (e.g., 9/10 overlap = 0.9)
   - When: should_halt(current, prior, 0.85)
   - Then: returns (True, "STABLE_HALT")

9. `test_should_halt_below_threshold`
   - Given: sets with Jaccard < 0.85 (e.g., 0.7)
   - When: should_halt
   - Then: returns (False, None)

10. `test_should_halt_zero_set_returns_halt`
    - Given: both sets empty
    - When: should_halt
    - Then: returns (True, "STABLE_HALT") since jaccard=1.0

All tests MUST FAIL (RED) before T5 implementation runs. Update `.test-index` with RED marker.

## Implementation Notes
- Test file: `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_stability.py`
- Import: `from dso_ci_review.stability import finding_hash, jaccard, should_halt`
- Findings represented as dicts: `{"file": "src/foo.py", "line_range": "10-20", "category": "correctness"}` or as 3-element list `["src/foo.py", "10-20", "correctness"]`
- finding_hash should accept either form; document the chosen form

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] test_stability.py exists with all 10 test functions
  Verify: grep -c "^def test_" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_stability.py | awk '{exit (\$1 < 10)}'
- [ ] All 10 tests FAIL (RED) before T5 implementation
  Verify: python -m pytest \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_stability.py 2>&1 | grep -qE "10 (errors|failed)|ModuleNotFoundError"
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker for stability.py
  Verify: grep "test_jaccard_zero_set_both_empty\|stability" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
